subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt the fixed 30-second WebSocket opening-handshake limit, accepting that exceptionally slow but eventually successful upgrades will instead reconnect?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and follows existing native-client precedent, but selecting an unconditional fail-closed limit changes runtime availability behavior for every existing Mattermost deployment and cannot be settled by CI alone.

options.title: Accept the fixed limit
options.body: Refresh the branch and merge the private 30-second native `ws` timeout, matching sibling connection-handshake policy without adding configuration surface.

options.title: Choose another fixed limit
options.body: Request an owner-approved constant and corresponding real proof if Mattermost deployments need a different bounded opening window.

options.title: Preserve unbounded upgrades
options.body: Pause or close the PR if compatibility with arbitrarily slow opening handshakes is more important than reconnect-loop availability.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed limit
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and merge the private 30-second native `ws` timeout, matching sibling connection-handshake policy without adding configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the Mattermost reconnect and close-before-open behavior that determines the effect of this timeout.
